Specialisation: oncology, gastroenterology

Main areas of specialisation:

Professor Dan Aderka is a leading gastrointestinal oncologist of international standing. He has deep knowledge and considerable experience in treating tumours of the digestive tract.

  • Neuroendocrine tumours
  • GIST tumours
  • Tumours of the oesophagus and stomach
  • Tumours of the liver and bile ducts
  • Tumours of the bowel
  • Shrinking metastases in the liver and abdomen in preparation for surgery
  • Tumours of unknown origin

Summary:

Professor Dan Aderka is a leading gastrointestinal oncologist with more than 30 years of clinical experience. He founded and heads a department for the treatment of tumours of the abdominal organs. Professor Aderka actively introduces the most innovative techniques in clinical oncology and radiotherapy, which today produce almost no serious side effects. His treatment is highly effective, with success rates above 90 per cent.

Dr Aderka also takes an active part in international cancer research, applies original clinical developments and is one of the founders of the Israeli association for the study of tumours of the digestive organs. He holds 10 scientific patents and has written more than 135 papers published in major international medical journals. Professor Aderka also teaches in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University.

Education and clinical experience:

  • Faculty of medicine: Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation in the treatment of internal disease: Beilinson clinic, Petah Tikva, Israel
  • Fellowship: Weizmann Institute of Science, Rehovot, Israel
  • Advanced training: University hospital, New York, USA
  • Specialisation in oncology: Tel Aviv medical centre, Israel

Academic and research work:

Professor Aderka is the author of more than 135 research papers and holds 10 scientific patents. He takes an active part in international congresses and conferences and shares his knowledge and experience with colleagues. He teaches in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University.

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy (ISCORT)
  • European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO)
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Professor Dan Aderka is known for his advanced treatment methods and high professionalism, thanks to which many patients have received medical care of the highest quality and improved their quality of life.

Rheumatologist

Main areas of specialisation

  • Treatment of diseases of the internal organs
  • Ankylosing spondylitis
  • Rheumatoid arthritis
  • Psoriatic arthritis
  • Osteoarthritis
  • Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)
  • Scleroderma
  • Gout
  • Sjögren's syndrome
  • Non-invasive examination of the capillaries of the soft tissues
  • Treatment of rheumatic disease with biological drugs

Summary

Professor Dan Caspi is one of Israel's most sought-after specialists in rheumatology. Since 2003 he has headed the Institute of Rheumatology, and he previously chaired the Israel Society of Rheumatology.

Professor Caspi specialises in the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of rheumatological conditions, such as rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), ankylosing spondylitis, scleroderma, gout and others. He is a highly qualified diagnostician who gives priority to reaching the correct diagnosis. Dr Caspi makes active use of the newest technologies to prevent the development of systemic disease, uses the latest generation of biological drugs and performs synovial biopsy.

Dr Caspi is a proponent of a comprehensive multidisciplinary approach, drawing specialists in narrow fields into the treatment of rheumatological disease: immunologists, cardiologists, vascular surgeons, neurologists, orthopaedic surgeons and physiotherapists.

Professor Dan Caspi has more than 45 years of experience. Alongside a busy clinical practice, he is actively engaged in research. His main interest is the use of the newest biological drugs in treating autoimmune disease. Professor Caspi is the author of more than 140 research papers and publishes the results of his work regularly in well-known medical journals.

Dr Caspi teaches younger doctors and helps organise advanced courses for experienced specialists, and lectures at international conferences. Professor Caspi belongs to international associations of rheumatologists and is an honorary member of the American College of Rheumatology. In 2002 he was awarded the title of professor of medicine for his contribution to rheumatology internationally and for his personal achievements.

Education and clinical experience

  • Medical college in Padua, Italy
  • Fellowship in internal medicine and rheumatology at Charing Cross Hospital, Hammersmith, United Kingdom
  • Fellowship in rheumatology at the Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Italian

Membership of international associations

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Society of Rheumatology
  • American College of Rheumatology

Dr Shlomo Davidovich: one of the world's leading doctors in neurosurgery and spinal surgery

Main areas of specialisation:

Shlomo Davidovich is one of Israel's leading specialists in spinal surgery and neurosurgery. He currently heads the department of neurosurgery and spinal surgery at the Assuta medical centre.

Professional activity:

Dr Davidovich specialises in a wide range of surgical interventions, including:

  • Minimally invasive discectomy for herniated discs.
  • Removal of spinal tumours.
  • Operations for spinal canal stenosis.
  • Surgical treatment of head injuries and brain tumours.
  • Treatment of migraine.

Education and clinical experience:

  • 1999: Completed his studies in the faculty of medicine at a university in Italy.
  • 2002: Specialised in neurosurgery in Israel.
  • 2005: Fellowship in endoscopic neurosurgery at clinics in Pittsburgh and Baltimore, USA.
  • 2008: Appointed spinal surgeon at the Ichilov medical centre.
  • 2009: Became senior surgeon in the spinal surgery department of the Rabin Medical Centre.
  • 2011: Invited to head the department of neurosurgery and spinal surgery at the Assuta medical centre.
  • 2013: Began private practice at the Herzliya Medical Centre.

Academic and research work:

Dr Davidovich takes an active part in teaching and research. He is a teacher at Drexel University in the United States and publishes his work regularly in international medical journals.

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Neurosurgical Society.
  • International society of endoscopic neurosurgery.

Dr Shlomo Davidovich is known for his outstanding contribution to the development of spinal surgery and neurosurgery, thanks to which many patients have been able to return to a full life.

Oncologist, urologist, uro-oncologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Pyelonephritis
  • Urethritis
  • Reconstruction of the urinary tract after injury and surgery
  • Correction of congenital abnormalities of the urinary and reproductive system
  • Testicular cancer
  • Tumours of the kidney

Summary:

Professor Jack Baniel is one of the world's leading specialists in urology and uro-oncology. He has 35 years of experience and treats adults and young patients alike.

Jack Baniel specialises in the treatment of conditions of the bladder, kidneys, adrenal glands, ureter, urethra, prostate and testes. He performs minimally invasive operations to remove tumours of the urinary and reproductive organs with great skill, and carries out delicate nerve-sparing uro-oncological operations.

Professor Baniel makes active use of the newest advances in medicine, such as the da Vinci surgical robot, the innovative drug Tookad combined with photodynamic therapy, and the GreenLight laser method. Thanks to modern techniques and technologies, he takes on the most difficult cases, which other doctors have considered untreatable. The main aim Professor Baniel sets himself is to preserve the affected organ and its function while minimising post-operative complications.

Jack Baniel began acquiring his professional skills during his service in the Israel Defence Forces. Many years of fellowships at leading clinics in Israel, South Africa and the United States made him a professional of the highest level.

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • European Association of Urology
  • European society of uro-oncology
  • American Urological Association
  • International association of urologists and uro-oncologists

Professor Ehud Raanani is an outstanding specialist in cardiothoracic surgery in Israel, with more than 25 years of experience. His expertise centres on the treatment of aortic aneurysm and the repair of heart valves. The professor performs the most complex and modern operations with great skill: coronary artery bypass grafting both on and off the heart-lung machine, heart valve replacement, surgical treatment of atrial fibrillation by the MAZE procedure, the removal of heart tumours and other surgical interventions. In most cases he uses hybrid operating theatres equipped with the latest medical technology, performing minimally invasive operations there, which helps avoid complications and considerably shortens recovery.

Education and medical practice

Professor Raanani took his medical degree at the faculty of health sciences of Tel Aviv University. He then completed a fellowship in Canada under the world-renowned Professor Tirone, where he specialised in operations for aortic aneurysm and in complex heart valve repair. On returning to Israel he actively introduced the newest methods in cardiothoracic surgery, founding the department for the treatment of aortic aneurysm at the Rabin Medical Centre in Petah Tikva.

Research and project leadership

Professor Raanani leads several international research projects on the development of the newest stents and methods of endovascular surgery. He also teaches at Tel Aviv University and is the author of more than 100 research papers published in leading medical journals.

Main areas of specialisation

  • Aortic aneurysm
  • Thoracic aortic aneurysm
  • Aortic stenosis
  • Velocardiofacial syndrome
  • Congenital heart defects
  • Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
  • Ventricular septal defect
  • Atrial septal defect
  • Arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia
  • Treatment of angina
  • Heart defects
  • Heart failure
  • Combined heart defects
  • Tachycardia

Methods Professor Raanani commands

  • Coronary artery bypass grafting
  • Hybrid operations
  • Heart valve replacement
  • Implantation of ICD devices
  • Therapeutic angiography — stenting of the coronary arteries
  • Open heart surgery

Membership of professional associations

Professor Raanani is a member of the Israel Society of Cardiothoracic Surgery and of many American and European associations connected with cardiac and thoracic surgery.

Dermatologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Psoriasis
  • Eczema
  • Erythema
  • Contact and atopic dermatitis
  • Vitiligo and other disorders of pigmentation
  • Fungal infections
  • Genetic skin disorders
  • Autoimmune skin disease
  • Parasitic skin disease
  • Precancerous skin lesions
  • Basal cell carcinoma
  • Melanoma

Summary:

Professor Eli Sprecher is one of the best-known and most sought-after dermatologists of international standing. He heads the dermatology department of the national cancer centre and the dermatology department at the Assuta medical centre. His work covers congenital and acquired skin disorders in adults and children of all ages.

Professor Sprecher is Israel's leading specialist in the diagnosis and treatment of allergic, autoimmune, infectious and other skin diseases. He carries out precise differential diagnosis of these conditions in the most complex and contested situations, and treats melanoma, the most aggressive malignant tumour of the skin. Each year he helps thousands of patients from all corners of the world, using every resource of modern medicine to treat the widest range of skin conditions.

Under Professor Sprecher's direction and with his direct participation, original treatments for certain genetic skin disorders were developed in the molecular dermatology laboratory, which he headed until 2008. Today he makes active use of experimental techniques developed very recently and not yet part of standard treatment, particularly in difficult cases of rare disease.

He has more than 30 years of clinical experience. Alongside a busy clinical practice, Professor Sprecher is actively engaged in research and has published more than 250 papers in the best-known medical journals of Israel, Europe and the United States. Many of his papers have been included in teaching materials for future dermatologists.

Eli Sprecher received an excellent medical education in Israel. Already a leading specialist in the treatment of skin disease, he visited Thomas Jefferson University in Philadelphia on a number of occasions, where he made an in-depth study of inherited predisposition to skin disorders.

Today Eli Sprecher is a professor in the department of dermatology in the faculty of medicine at the Technion in Haifa. He also chairs the examination board for future specialists in dermatology. He holds several prestigious awards from the American Academy of Dermatology and the Society for Pediatric Dermatology.

Additional specialisation:

  • Hyperhidrosis
  • Seborrhoea
  • Treatment of alopecia (hair loss) in women and children
  • Disorders of the hair and nails
  • Skin cancer

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Technion, Haifa, Israel
  • Postgraduate study of genetic predisposition to skin disorders at Thomas Jefferson University, Philadelphia, USA
  • Residency in dermatology and venereology in the department of skin and venereal diseases at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society of Dermatology and Venereology
  • Israel Society of Medical Genetics
  • American Society of Human Genetics
  • Society for Investigative Dermatology, USA
  • American Academy of Dermatology
